pages.title: The Castle Inn: Riverfront Hotel in Downtown Helen Georgia
pages.description: The Castle Inn offers Bavarian style hotel rooms set directly on Main Street in Downtown Helen, Georgia, on the banks of the Chattahoochee River. With downtown Helen just down the stairs, you can easily explore the many shops, restaurants, and attractions that Alpine Helen has to offer. Complimentary parking is included with your stay.
pages.text:

The Castle Inn: Riverfront Hotel in Downtown Helen Georgia
top of page
Plan Your Next Getaway
Come and experience the old-world charm of The Castle Inn. All of our rooms are uniquely furnished to make you feel at home, while still providing that distinctive Bavarian style. We offer rooms with picturesque views of Main Street or the Chattahoochee River.
And with downtown Helen just down the stairs, you can easily explore the many shops, restaurants, and attractions that Alpine Helen has to offer. We provide complimentary parking to ensure that your stay is as hassle-free as possible.​
Accommodations
Choose from our charming hotel rooms overlooking Main Street or the Chattahoochee River, or opt for our one-bedroom suite. For larger groups or families, we offer a cozy 2- or 3-bedroom condo, centrally located in Helen.
See Our Rooms
Concierge Services
Enhance your stay with a bottle of wine from award-winning local Habersham Winery, a dozen roses, a gourmet cheese & fruit basket, or let our team craft a custom package tailored to your preferences and budget.
Learn More
The Castle Inn
8580 North Main Street
Helen, Georgia 30545

Hotel | The Castle Inn
top of page
Rooms & Rates
Welcome to the Castle Inn, where you can choose from a variety of charming Bavarian-style rooms. Additionally, we are pleased to offer a cozy condo, perfect for those seeking a home-away-from-home atmosphere. Come and enjoy the perfect blend of comfort and convenience during your stay!
​
Please note the Castle Inn is NOT handicap accessible.
Guests will need to use stairs to access the hotel rooms as there is no elevator. Rooms are located one level up from Main Street and two levels up from the parking lot.
Guest Rooms
​ ​ Mini Fridge
Sitting Area
Flat Screen TV with Cable
Complimentary Coffee
Patio with views of the river or Main Street (depending on room selection - based on availability)
Stairs required
​ ​
King, Queen, and Double Queen rooms available

Arts, Culture, History | The Castle Inn
top of page
Culture, Arts, & History
For visitors interested in culture, arts, and history, consider visiting the Folk Pottery Museum, exploring the historic Hardman Farm, or stopping by the Helen Arts & Heritage Center.
Historic Hardman Farm
Just outside of Helen, the Hardman Farm State Historic Site offers educational guided house tours. Take a scenic walk on the Helen to Hardman Farm Heritage Trail along the Chattahoochee River.
Mark of the Potter
Opened in 1969, Mark of the Potter is the oldest running pottery shop in the state. With a beautiful selection of pottery from local artists, this shop is worth the drive.
Folk Pottery Museum
In nearby Sautee Nacoochee, the Folk Pottery Museum to showcases local folk pottery and explores the history of folk pottery in the region.
Helen Arts & Heritage Center
Located in downtown Helen, the Helen Arts & Heritage Center includes a local history museum, art gallery, pottery studio, and gift shop.
Explore More
Please visit The Alpine Helen & White County Conference & Visitors Bureau and the Helen Chamber of Commerce for more information on things to do if you're interested in arts, culture, and history.
